# Piyush Modi — Senior Product Designer

> Personal portfolio of Piyush Modi, a senior product designer with 9+ years of experience in enterprise UX, design systems, and internal tools. Currently at Apple.

Site: https://piyushmodi.com

## About

Piyush Modi is a senior product designer based in Sacramento, CA. He designs internal tools, platforms, and design systems — the kind of software people open every morning and depend on to do their jobs.

Career: Deloitte Consulting (2017–2020) → Tapestry via Publicis Sapient (2020–2021) → MathWorks (2022–2024) → Apple (2025–present). Also runs Capmov, a design consultancy side practice.

Education: MS Human-Computer Interaction, San Jose State University. BCA Computer Applications, Symbiosis International University.

Contact: piyushmodi01@gmail.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/piyushmodi01/

## Case Studies

- [Improving MATLAB's Plot Viewing Experience](https://piyushmodi.com/work/matlab-plot-viewer): Only 1 of 7 engineers could find a key MATLAB feature. Redesigned within codebase constraints — task completion improved from 1/7 to 7/7, task time dropped from 35–45s to 5–8s.

- [Designing Salesforce Forms for Government](https://piyushmodi.com/work/salesforce-forms): Configurable form platform for US government data collection at Deloitte. Two modes on one platform: conversational UI for citizens, traditional for case workers. Deployed across 5+ state programs.

- [Apple Internal Products](https://piyushmodi.com/work/apple): Internal tools and design systems used by thousands of Apple employees daily. NDA — walkthrough available on request.

## Blog

- [Are You Solving the Right UX Problem?](https://piyushmodi.com/blog/how-to-validate-true-user-needs): Two quick techniques — 5 Whys and So What? — to find the real problem before designing.

- [The Power of Storytelling in UX Presentations](https://piyushmodi.com/blog/power-of-storytelling): How designers can present ideas in ways that resonate with non-designer stakeholders. Originally published on UXMatters.

## Side Projects

- Accessibility Checker: Bookmarklet + Sketch plugin + browser extension that audits text, contrast, and structure. Adopted across design and PM teams.
- AG-Grid Builder: React tool for generating code-accurate data table exports for design files.
- Design Agent: Tool for PMs to self-serve design gap analysis from a BRD before it reaches a designer.
- Symbol Override Manager: Sketch plugin for managing symbol overrides at scale.
